description: Returns the full text, price and site link for a record id. Id format: <tur|deneyim|otel|vize>:<tr|en>:<EUR|USD|AED>:<key> (tour, experience, hotel, visa); change only the currency part to switch currency. A tour record carries itinerary, inclusions, exclusions, hotels and departures, and names what it lacks. An unpublished record returns NOT_FOUND.

id.description: Record id, format as in the tool description.
